game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: In Relic Vault, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the moon altar using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the moon altar is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Relic Vault'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Relic Vault.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The moon altar reached with actions_used <= 14.
